items.rationale: The model remembers nothing across sessions, so the program must persist the fact and put it back in context. Saying the model will remember, or that the old conversation carries over automatically, is wrong.
Retrieval brings in only the relevant pages when needed, keeping tokens and cost low. A larger window still costs tokens on every call and does not solve the cost.

items.answer: More text costs more tokens on every call, and the irrelevant text can distract the model so it recalls or uses the right facts less accurately.
accepted: the model gets distracted by irrelevant text
items.rationale: Either cost per call or reduced accuracy as the window fills (context rot) is a valid reason.
